title: Grateful Dead Live at Alpine Valley Music Theatre on 1989-07-17
lineage: Master Cassettes (Maxell MX 100) Tascam 112MKII -> Korg MR-1, 1bit 2.8MHz -> USB -> Korg Audio Gate Software 24bit 96KHz -> Wave Lab 6.0 w/UAD -> R8brain for 16bit 44.1KHz sample rate conversion -> Traders Little Helper flac 8 -> Tagged w/Tag & Rename
source: Nakamichi CM-300's with CP4 shotgun caps -> Sony TC-D5M ("1st two nights we were up on the lawn shooting at the repeater stacks from very close range")

ai_review.summary: Good audience recording with clear sound despite mixed opinions on noise reduction; the show’s Goin’ Down the Road tease draws attention.
ai_review.review: The audience‑sourced tape is generally praised for its clean, well‑balanced sound, though one reviewer feels the noise reduction was over‑applied. Performance‑wise there are no major complaints, with a brief discussion of the Goin' Down The Road ending that shows listeners were engaged with the set. Overall the recording is considered listenable and enjoyable.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers give 4‑5 stars and commend the clean audience sound; a single low rating about noise reduction tempers the score, leading to a solid but not flawless rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally clear with minimal processing; some listeners note phasing from repeater stacks and faint echo from house mics. One reviewer objects to heavy noise reduction, while others confirm none was applied.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific comments on overall set pacing; only a note about the Goin' Down The Road ending being treated as part of the song rather than a separate tease.
